verdict: Grafana Cloud: Choose Grafana Cloud when managed Grafana/LGTM telemetry is the job — not Datadog host modules and not ITSM. Scores use the IT & Development editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
strengths: Dashboards as the centre of gravity
bestFor: Startups that fit in the Free telemetry caps
Platform teams that want Mimir/Loki without operating it
notIdealFor: Buyers who want Datadog-style host SKUs and a single APM vendor UX
tradeoffs: Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models
Module stacking and consumption overages vs single-SKU floors
Free tiers vs enterprise SSO/audit gates
Landscape-adjacent tools vs primary job-cluster peers on best pages
recommendation: Choose Grafana Cloud when managed Grafana/LGTM telemetry is the job — not Datadog host modules and not ITSM. Compare Datadog or New Relic for all-in-one APM suites; PagerDuty for paging.
editorialNotes: IT Priority-2 batch. Approved on it-development-editorial v1.0.0. membershipRole=primary. jobCluster=observability-monitoring. handsOnTesting=false. Affiliate economics excluded.

Managed observability — cluster peer of Datadog/New Relic, not PagerDuty-only on-call.

Huge data-source ecosystem; Cloud is the hosted version of that.
Enterprise SKU carries SAML/audit; Pro is usage-grade.
Usage pricing scales; Enterprise commit for large estates.
Best Free telemetry cap in this wave; Pro is honest usage. Affiliate economics excluded.
AI is not the Grafana Cloud buying reason vs dashboards and telemetry.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ITSM, observability, source control, hosting panels, and web-data platforms are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
